decision.explanation: Both awards are directly stated in their respective documents as having been received by Nakamura Kenzaburo XVII. Document D1S8 states he received the Order of Culture in 2011, while Document D2S8 states he received the Grand Cross of the Civil Order of Alfonso XII in 2001. These are distinct awards attributed to two different referents sharing the same name.
